entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:1
segments: ¶"Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; And hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:2
segments: Let my teaching drop as the rain, My speech distill as the dew, As raindrops on the tender herb, And as showers on the grass.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:3
segments: For I proclaim the name of the LORD: Ascribe greatness to our God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:4
segments: [He is] the Rock, His work [is] perfect; For all His ways [are] justice, A God of truth and without injustice; Righteous and upright [is] He.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:5
segments: "They have corrupted themselves; [They are] not His children, Because of their blemish: A perverse and crooked generation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:6
segments: Do you thus deal with the LORD, O foolish and unwise people? [Is] He not your Father, [who] bought you? Has He not made you and established you?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:7
segments: ¶"Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; Your elders, and they will tell you:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:8
segments: When the Most High divided their inheritance to the nations, When He separated the sons of Adam, He set the boundaries of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:9
segments: For the LORD'S portion [is] His people; Jacob [is] the place of His inheritance.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:10
segments: "He found him in a desert land And in the wasteland, a howling wilderness; He encircled him, He instructed him, He kept him as the apple of His eye.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:11
segments: As an eagle stirs up its nest, Hovers over its young, Spreading out its wings, taking them up, Carrying them on its wings,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:12
segments: [So] the LORD alone led him, And [there was] no foreign god with him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:13
segments: "He made him ride in the heights of the earth, That he might eat the produce of the fields; He made him draw honey from the rock, And oil from the flinty rock;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:14
segments: Curds from the cattle, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs; And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the choicest wheat; And you drank wine, the blood of the grapes.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:15
segments: ¶"But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; You grew fat, you grew thick, You are obese! Then he forsook God [who] made him, And scornfully esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:16
segments: They provoked Him to jealousy with foreign [gods]; With abominations they provoked Him to anger.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:17
segments: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, [To gods] they did not know, To new [gods], new arrivals That your fathers did not fear.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:18
segments: Of the Rock [who] begot you, you are unmindful, And have forgotten the God who fathered you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:19
segments: ¶"And when the LORD saw [it], He spurned [them], Because of the provocation of His sons and His daughters.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:20
segments: And He said: 'I will hide My face from them, I will see what their end [will be], For they [are] a perverse generation, Children in whom [is] no faith.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:21
segments: They have provoked Me to jealousy by [what] is not God; They have moved Me to anger by their foolish idols. But I will provoke them to jealousy by [those who are] not a nation; I will move them to anger by a foolish nation.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:22
segments: For a fire is kindled by my anger, And shall burn to the lowest hell; It shall consume the earth with her increase, And set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:23
segments: 'I will heap disasters on them; I will spend My arrows on them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:24
segments: [They shall be] wasted with hunger, Devoured by pestilence and bitter destruction; I will also send against them the teeth of beasts, With the poison of serpents of the dust.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:25
segments: The sword shall destroy outside; [There shall be] terror within For the young man and virgin, The nursing child with the man of gray hairs.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:26
segments: ¶I would have said, "I will dash them in pieces, I will make the memory of them to cease from among men,"

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:27
segments: Had I not feared the wrath of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should misunderstand, Lest they should say, "Our hand [is] high; And it is not the LORD who has done all this."'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:28
segments: "For they [are] a nation void of counsel, Nor [is there any] understanding in them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:29
segments: Oh, that they were wise, [that] they understood this, [That] they would consider their latter end!

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:30
segments: How could one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Unless their Rock had sold them, And the LORD had surrendered them?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:31
segments: For their rock [is] not like our Rock, Even our enemies themselves [being] judges.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:32
segments: For their vine [is] of the vine of Sodom And of the fields of Gomorrah; Their grapes [are] grapes of gall, Their clusters [are] bitter.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:33
segments: Their wine [is] the poison of serpents, And the cruel venom of cobras.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:34
segments: '[Is] this not laid up in store with Me, Sealed up among My treasures?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:35
segments: Vengeance is Mine, and recompense; Their foot shall slip in [due] time; For the day of their calamity [is] at hand, And the things to come hasten upon them.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:36
segments: "For the LORD will judge His people And have compassion on His servants, When He sees that [their] power is gone, And [there is] no one [remaining], bond or free.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:37
segments: He will say: 'Where [are] their gods, The rock in which they sought refuge?

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:38
segments: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices, [And] drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise and help you, [And] be your refuge.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:39
segments: ¶'Now see that I, [even] I, [am] He, And [there is] no God besides Me; I kill and I make alive; I wound and I heal; Nor [is there any] who can deliver from My hand.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:40
segments: For I raise My hand to heaven, And say, "[As] I live forever,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:41
segments: If I whet My glittering sword, And My hand takes hold on judgment, I will render vengeance to My enemies, And repay those who hate Me.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:42
segments: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, And My sword shall devour flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the heads of the leaders of the enemy."'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:43
segments: "Rejoice, O Gentiles, [with] His people; For He will avenge the blood of His servants, And render vengeance to His adversaries; He will provide atonement for His land [and] His people."

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:44
segments: ¶So Moses came with Joshua the son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:45
segments: Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:46
segments: and He said to them: "Set your hearts on all the words which I testify among you today, which you shall command your children to be careful to observe-all the words of this law.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:47
segments: "For it [is] not a futile thing for you, because it [is] your life, and by this word you shall prolong [your] days in the land which you cross over the Jordan to possess."

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:48
segments: Then the LORD spoke to Moses that very same day, saying:

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:49
segments: "Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which [is] in the land of Moab, across from Jericho; view the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel as a possession;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:50
segments: "and die on the mountain which you ascend, and be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:51
segments: "because you trespassed against Me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin, because you did not hallow Me in the midst of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 32:52
segments: "Yet you shall see the land before [you], though you shall not go there, into the land which I am giving to the children of Israel."
